result:
Typecheck and the full test suite (617 tests) pass clean. Summary of what was fixed, all per ADR 0009's vocabulary (status groups, `me`, labels all-of, `assignee=none`, `due_before`, `archived=only`):

- **`src/types/issue.ts`** — added `IssueStatusGroup`/`expandIssueStatusToken(s)`; `IssueFilter.assigneeId`/`authorId` now allow `"me"`; `dueBefore` is a plain string (date-or-timestamp); added `archivedOnly`.
- **`src/hooks/issue-filter-params.ts`** — codec now expands `status=open/closed`, passes `me` through unresolved, supports `archived=only`, and exposes `readableParamsFromRecord`/`splitList` so pages stop parsing the URL themselves.
- **`src/lib/date.ts`** — added `resolveDueBeforeCutoff` (calendar date → whole day included; timestamp → strict).
- **`src/schemas/common.ts`/`issue.ts`/`export.ts`** — schema now accepts/refuses the same status groups and `me`, and `due_before` accepts both formats; export schema shares the status vocabulary.
- **`src/server/repositories/issue-repository.ts`** — fixed `assigneeId: null` (unassigned) being swallowed by truthiness check; labels are now all-of (`having count(distinct label) = N`); added `archivedOnly` (archived-only listing); due_before uses the resolved cutoff; added a guard against unresolved `"me"` reaching the repo.
- **`src/server/services/issue-service.ts`** — resolves `"me"` against the acting user before hitting the repository.
- **Both issue-list pages** (`.../issues/page.tsx` and `.../[orgSlug]/issues/page.tsx`) — now parse the URL via the shared codec/schema instead of hand-rolling `search.status`/`search.q`/`search.archived`, so label/assignee/due_before/priority filters actually take effect and the sidebar's `assignee=me` link works.
- **`src/app/api/export/issues/route.ts`** — now reads `status`/`priority` from the URL and forwards them, so `status=open` is accepted.
- **`src/components/domain/issue/issue-filter-bar.tsx`** — added Open/Closed group chips alongside the six status chips.
